From analyzing your immediate environment to supporting your wellness, the advanced reasoning capabilities of Muse Spark enable powerful, highly personal use cases.</p><p><b>Multimodal. </b>Muse Spark is built from the ground up to integrate visual information across domains and tools. It achieves strong performance on visual STEM questions, entity recognition, and localization. These capabilities come together to enable interactive experiences like creating fun minigames or troubleshooting your home appliances with dynamic annotations.</p><p><b>Health. </b>One major application of personal superintelligence is to help people learn about and improve their health. To improve Muse Spark's health reasoning capabilities, we collaborated with over 1,000 physicians to curate training data that enables more factual and comprehensive responses. Muse Spark can generate interactive displays that unpack and explain health information such as the nutritional content of various foods or muscles activated during exercise.</p></div></div><div class="_a5gf _a5gl _a5i6 _a5jk"></div><div class="_asv6 _metaAICarouselScalingImage__mobileOverflow _asv9 _asve _asvh"><noscript id="u_0_6_gd"></noscript></div><div class="_9bhp _9bhq _9bg- _9bh0 _9bh9 _9bhv _9998 _ar3s _as9p _9mp7 _8h4k"><h3 class="_a92o _a5e5 _a5w7">Scaling Axes</h3><div class="_a5ci _a5cs _a92o _a5c- _a5w7"><p>To build personal superintelligence, our model’s capabilities should scale predictably and efficiently. Below, we share how we study and track Muse Spark's scaling properties along three axes: pretraining, reinforcement learning, and test-time reasoning.</p><p><b>Pretraining</b>. The pretraining phase is where Muse Spark acquires its core multimodal understanding, reasoning, and coding abilities — the foundation that reinforcement learning and test-time compute build upon.</p><p>Over the last nine months, we rebuilt our pretraining stack with improvements to model architecture, optimization, and data curation. Together, these advancements increase the capability we can extract from every unit of compute. To rigorously evaluate our new recipe, we fit a scaling law to a series of small models and compare the training FLOPs required to hit a specific level of performance. The results are clear: we can reach the same capabilities with over an order of magnitude less compute than our previous model, Llama 4 Maverick. This improvement also makes Muse Spark significantly more efficient than the leading base models available for comparison.</p></div><div class="_a5gf _a5gk _a5i6 _a5jk"></div></div><div class="_9bhp _9bhq _9bhs _9bh0 _9bh9 _9bhv _9998 _ar3s _as9p _9mp7 _8h4k"><img class="_as9p _1-qs _9mk0 img" src="https://scontent-lax3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/667580961_1557898095990047_8798526624523628592_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=BjAGYeWfkFQQ7kNvwGBJa2E&_nc_oc=AdrsPozMcIdhkbatqF7YBqKyTO9b7nQuoN1wEhcKDO1F5YW3sNwlq5bxcjiVbqbmBEA&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-1.xx&_nc_gid=NimsdQDXiE7bZwv5gOFEqQ&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_Af9mMoOteTpQ-f3LqxuU5a1-Nthrj6ygZoBZ9VYsGkwt2w&oe=6A3B9463" alt="" id="u_0_7_mV" style="border-top-left-radius:px;border-top-right-radius:px;border-bottom-left-radius:px;border-bottom-right-radius:px;" /></div><div class="_9bhp _9bhq _9bhs _9bh0 _9bh9 _9bhv _9998 _ar3s _as9p _9mp7 _8h4k"><div class="_a5gf _a5gl _a5i6 _a5jj"></div><div class="_a5ci _a5cs _a92o _a5c- _a5w7"><p><b>Reinforcement Learning.</b> After pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL) leverages compute to scalably amplify model capabilities. Even though large-scale RL is notoriously prone to instability, our new stack delivers smooth, predictable gains.</p><p>The plots below show the benefits of scaling RL compute (measured in steps) for Muse Spark. On the left, we see log-linear growth in pass@1 and pass@16 (at least one success across 16 attempts) on the training data. This indicates that RL is improving model reliability without compromising reasoning diversity. On the right, accuracy growth on a held-out evaluation set establishes that the gains from RL predictably generalize: Muse Spark smoothly improves on tasks that were not seen in training.</p></div><div class="_a5gf _a5gl _a5i6 _a5jj"></div></div><div class="_9bhp _9bhq _9bhs _9bh0 _9bh9 _9bhv _9998 _ar3s _as9p _9mp7 _8h4l"><img class="_as9p _1-qs _9mk0 img" src="https://scontent-lax3-2.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t39.2365-6/668545857_966866959131364_8191359885166725237_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=e280be&_nc_ohc=vCnf1bkZ-gEQ7kNvwGMNWDx&_nc_oc=Adpg4wrpSPKdg_9n6BckOVwuF1aoIUBwMXyJImGSVOsXLkC3qIugcflQKhobEr53ho8&_nc_zt=14&_nc_ht=scontent-lax3-2.xx&_nc_gid=NimsdQDXiE7bZwv5gOFEqQ&_nc_ss=7b20f&oh=00_Af8ErBd1RzzNh2aPnX2OAVMbWChOw3Lgb__zqVu4pXgxDg&oe=6A3B85FF" alt="" id="u_0_8_hr" style="border-top-left-radius:px;border-top-right-radius:px;border-bottom-left-radius:px;border-bottom-right-radius:px;" /><div class="_a5gf _a5gk _a5i6 _a5jk"></div></div><div class="_9bhp _9bhq _9bhs _9bh0 _9bh9 _9bhv _9998 _ar3s _as9p _9mp7 _8h4k"><div class="_a5ci _a5cs _a92o _a5c- _a5w7"><p><b>Test-Time Reasoning.</b> RL trains our models to "think" before they answer — a process known as test-time reasoning. Serving this capability to billions of users requires efficient use of reasoning tokens. On a subset of evaluations such as AIME, this causes a phase transition.
